correctness.rationale: There are 31 rational points/lines of PG(2,5), 10 homogeneous cubic monomials, (5^10−1)/(5−1)=2,441,406 scalar-normalized equations. A rational smooth curve point has a unique nonzero gradient whose orthogonal 6-point rational line is its tangent; union masks yield coverage. Independently programmed an exact GF(5) C enumerator for ALL normalized equations, recovered complete 32-bin source histogram, maximum 29 and 186,000 winners, with 93,000 each at rational point counts 8 and 10. Independently generated five polynomial substitution matrices and enumerated all 186,000 maximizing forms under GL3 generator action; exactly TWO PGL3 orbits each 93,000. |PGL3(F5)|=372,000 gives stabilizer four. Read actual source independently implemented gradient and flag enumerators and their polynomial code: both finite methods exhaust same domain; projective representative checks and partial derivative contradictions over algebraic closure prove geometric smoothness for each representative. Verification is finite exhaustive of exactly the claimed fixed field; none asserts other fields.
